checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: All loose items on both counters and sinks are gone.

must.item: Brown cabinets and beige tiles remain
must.why: Cabinets, handles and tiles look the same as the source.
Sink, tap, outlets, window, white unit and framing are unchanged.
Counters look clean and seamless with no visible remnants; only slightly smooth in places.

faults.what: The white electric kettle was removed too. It is arguably an appliance, not loose clutter.
The right sink's left bowl now shows a perforated insert or strainer-like texture, and the counter surface is a bit smooth.

summary: The counters and sinks are cleanly cleared and the cabinets, tiles and layout are intact; the only issues are the kettle also being removed and a slightly smooth right-sink area.
